# **My Professional Experience**

My experience spans environmental education, youth programming, 
community organizing, and small business development. I have worked 
directly with youth in afterschool programs, outdoor education, and 
coastal conservation outreach, while also serving in leadership roles 
in campus sustainability and environmental advocacy.

I am passionate about connecting people to the environment and to each 
other. I believe that hands-on, place-based education is one of the 
most powerful tools we have for building a generation that cares about 
the world around them.

For those interested in seeing a formal write-up of my experiences,
